description: This file provides utility functions for processing Markdown content, including stripping Markdown syntax, decoding HTML entities, converting Markdown to HTML, and rendering Markdown nodes with custom renderers. It is part of the Mattermost project and handles Markdown parsing and rendering logic.

classes.name: notificationRenderer
classes.description: Custom renderer for Markdown nodes to control how Markdown is rendered into plain text or HTML.

methods.name: newNotificationRenderer
methods.description: Constructor for notificationRenderer, initializes a new renderer instance.

methods.name: RegisterFuncs
methods.description: Registers rendering functions for different Markdown node types.

methods.name: renderDefault
methods.description: Default rendering function that performs no changes.

methods.name: renderItem
methods.description: Renders list items, headings, and paragraphs with spacing.

methods.name: renderCodeBlock
methods.description: Renders code blocks by writing their lines.

methods.name: renderFencedCodeBlock
methods.description: Renders fenced code blocks similarly to code blocks.

methods.name: renderText
methods.description: Renders inline text nodes, handling line breaks.

methods.name: renderTextBlock
methods.description: Renders text blocks, adding spacing between blocks.

methods.name: writeLines
methods.description: Writes all lines of a code or text block to the output.
